head: 24d6ea54f2d2f7013a28d85fb9a7803b05295797
implementationPerformed: none — evidence retrieval, analysis and documentation only

costModel.caveat: These are the rates the product's own accounting uses. Whether they match the provider's actual billed rates is an owner check §320 cannot perform without a provider-account read, and it is not asserted.

developmentObservationsNotUsedForProject.reason: Development requests are ~19x smaller because production assembles the full inspection context. Projecting from them would understate spend by about 5x.

hz11.keyFinding: Moving the analysis count from 1 to 5 requires NO change to the USD cap — one environment variable, not two. The USD cap is a hard spend bound in every scenario.
hz11.evaluationSplit: The deterministic path is unlimited and customer-authoritative, so a Beta at any of these ceilings evaluates the core product. At 1/day Expert itself cannot be evaluated at all.
hz11.recommendation: Raise the analysis count to 5, leave the USD cap at $1.00. If spend dominates, DISABLE Expert rather than leaving it at 1 — one per day pays for Expert and learns nothing about it.

retentionFacts.activeProductData: indefinite by construction; no period, no export guarantee, no Beta-end statement — this absence IS ST-3
retentionFacts.evidenceErasure: tombstone -> erasure_pending -> erased from R2; nothing serves erasure_pending; the nightly reconciler propagates erasures into the recovery store
retentionFacts.accountDeletion: access removed, user row anonymised, evidence erased from R2 end to end (§313, exercised in production at §313A, §314A, §317A)
retentionFacts.auditRecords: security_audit_events and audit_logs are NOT erased by account deletion, deliberately
retentionFacts.knownLatentGap: BR-6 — user.password is a tolerated legacy column the entity does not declare, so anonymisation does not clear it and it would survive in backups. Not realised in production.
retentionFacts.recommendation: Option A — describe what the system already does. Costs nothing and is true today.

brand.singleSourceOfTruth: frontend-next/lib/brand.ts (APP_NAME, AI_ENGINE_NAME, APP_TAGLINE) and backend PRODUCT_NAME
mustChangeBeforeBeta: customer-facing product name, titles, footer, report header/footer
canChangeAfter: Stripe descriptors (no charges in a comped Beta)
shouldNotRenameForBranding: frozen verification paths — §274 established that paths participate in evidence identity
brand.rule: Rename what a customer reads; leave what a machine reads.

timing.stays: no technical impact; TM-1 stays open; §318/§319 already mitigated the CLAIM risk
timing.beforeBeta: 186 customer-visible strings plus AI_ENGINE_NAME; bundled with the product rename it is one copy pass
timing.afterBeta: the same strings PLUS every report participants already hold, which §286's revision model deliberately preserves exactly as issued and therefore cannot rewrite

hazlenzName.recommendation: Decide it with the product name, before Beta. The timing is the cheap part and stays cheap only until the first participant receives a report.

remaining.domain: owner action, gated on brand — cannot be a vercel.app subdomain
remaining.dnsProvider: owner action; exact records issued at creation and not knowable in advance
remaining.endToEndProof: one real reset message reaching a real mailbox

em2.consequenceWhileOpen: a participant who forgets their password is permanently locked out of that account; the designed support procedure is deletion and re-invitation

cohortRecommendation.reason: matches the cohort size the project's own claims guardrails assume; keeps 30-day provider spend at $28.62-$143.12; keeps support and recovery inside what one operator can carry with no support surface and no self-serve recovery
cohortRecommendation.bindingConstraint: not money — EM-2 open, no support surface, and the nightly integrity job runs on a laptop, all of which scale with participants while the operator does not
cohortRecommendation.expandTo10: once EM-2 closes and a support path exists

counselPackage.recommendation: Wait for the brand decision so the 17 brand occurrences in the legal text are reviewed once rather than twice. Brand lock is the critical path either way.

mustCompleteBeforeBetaButNotBeforeReview: HZ-11 value set and read back

recommendedDecisionOrder: 1. Brand (product name + HazLenz) — unblocks EM-2, TM-1 and the legal review
2. Beta mode — comped recommended; decides the plan surfaces
3. HZ-11 — 5/day at the existing USD cap, or disable Expert
4. HZ-12 — set the threshold, and decide the disclosure
5. ST-3 — Option A, wording into the legal batch
6. Support contact — needed before the page review
9. EM-2 activation once brand and domain exist
